a resident doctor: After graduating from medical school, my cousin worked as a resident doctor at a busy hospital in Taipei.
從醫學院畢業後，我表哥在台北一家忙碌的醫院擔任住院醫師。
the resident population: During the summer, tourists double the town's size, but the resident population is only about five thousand people.
夏天時遊客讓小鎮人數倍增，但常住人口其實只有大約五千人。
be resident in: Foreigners who have been resident in Taiwan for more than five years may apply for permanent residence.
居住於台灣超過五年的外國人可以申請永久居留。
a resident expert: Mr. Lin is our office's resident expert on computers, so everyone asks him when a laptop stops working.
林先生是我們辦公室的駐地電腦專家，所以筆電一壞大家都找他。
a residential area: The new night market will not be built here because this is a quiet residential area full of families.
新夜市不會蓋在這裡，因為這是一個住滿家庭的安靜住宅區。
residential care: When Grandma could no longer live alone, our family decided she needed residential care with nurses nearby.
當奶奶再也無法獨居時，我們家決定她需要有護理師在旁的住宿型照護。
a residential course: The summer English camp is a residential course, so students sleep in the school dorms for two weeks.
這個暑期英語營是住宿型課程，所以學生要在學校宿舍住兩個星期。
a respectable income: She is not rich, but her job as an engineer gives her a respectable income and plenty of free time.
她並不富有，但工程師的工作給了她相當不錯的收入和充足的空閒時間。
a respectable family: He came from a respectable family that everyone in the village trusted and admired.
他出身於一個村裡每個人都信任且欽佩的體面家庭。
a respectable score: I didn't get full marks on the math test, but eighty-five is still a respectable score.
我數學考試沒有拿滿分，但八十五分仍然是個像樣的分數。
be respectful of others: When you share a dorm room, you must be respectful of others and keep the noise down at night.
和別人共用宿舍時，你必須尊重他人，晚上要保持安靜。
a respectful distance: The photographers kept a respectful distance from the family at the funeral and did not take close-up pictures.
攝影師們在喪禮上和家屬保持著保持敬意的距離，沒有拍特寫照片。
a respectful silence: The whole school stood in a respectful silence for one minute to remember the victims of the earthquake.
全校肅靜站立一分鐘，悼念地震的罹難者。
respectful of tradition: The young chef is creative but respectful of tradition, so his dishes still taste like his grandmother's cooking.
這位年輕主廚很有創意卻尊重傳統，所以他的菜吃起來仍有他奶奶的味道。
the retail price: The retail price of the new phone is thirty thousand dollars, but some online shops sell it for less.
這支新手機的零售價是三萬元，但有些網路商店賣得比較便宜。
retail therapy: After a stressful week of exams, Amy enjoyed some retail therapy and bought three new shirts at the mall.
在壓力很大的考試週之後，艾咪在購物中心享受了一下購物療法，買了三件新上衣。
a retail outlet: The company sells most of its shoes online, but it also has a retail outlet near the train station.
這家公司大部分的鞋子都在網路上賣，但在火車站附近也有一間零售店。
the retail trade: Many young people work in the retail trade during summer vacation, selling clothes or snacks in shops.
許多年輕人暑假時在零售業工作，在店裡賣衣服或零食。
in reverse order: The teacher read our test scores in reverse order, starting with the lowest and ending with the highest.
老師以相反順序念出我們的考試成績，從最低分開始，到最高分結束。
the reverse side: Please write your name and class number on the reverse side of the answer sheet before you hand it in.
交卷前請在答案卷的背面寫上你的姓名和座號。
quite the reverse: Some people think the new rule made students lazy, but quite the reverse is true; they study harder now.
有些人認為新規定讓學生變懶，但事實恰恰相反；他們現在更用功了。
reverse discrimination: Some students complained that the special program for one group was a kind of reverse discrimination against everyone else.
有些學生抱怨，專為某一群人設的特別計畫對其他人來說是一種逆向歧視。
reverse a decision: After watching the video replay, the referee had to reverse a decision he had made earlier in the game.
看完重播影片後，裁判不得不推翻他在比賽稍早做出的決定。
put the car in reverse: The parking space was too narrow, so Dad had to put the car in reverse and slowly back out.
停車位太窄了，所以爸爸只好倒車，慢慢地退出來。
reverse psychology: My mom used reverse psychology, telling my brother he was too young to wash dishes, and he did them at once.
我媽使用反向心理，告訴我弟他太小不能洗碗，結果他馬上就去洗了。
a revolutionary idea: Selling books online was a revolutionary idea in the 1990s, but now almost everyone shops that way.
在一九九〇年代，網路賣書是一個革命性的想法，但現在幾乎每個人都這樣購物。
revolutionary technology: Smartphones are a revolutionary technology that completely changed how people talk, shop, and study.
智慧型手機是一項革命性的技術，徹底改變了人們溝通、購物和學習的方式。
revolutionary change: The internet brought revolutionary change to the way students do homework and search for information.
網路為學生寫作業和搜尋資料的方式帶來了根本性變革。
